description: SmartCity Management API (apps/api): RED metrics per route, route cache, pod runtime, logs (Loki) and traces (Tempo). Source: smartcity-management helm/dashboards/scmp-api.json.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description: All responses of the selected routes, any status.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of responses that were a 500. 4xx are the caller's problem and are not counted (see the Traffic row).

panels.title: Latency p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the request duration over the selected routes.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Server-side route cache (Redis) hits over all lookups. Only routes that declare `cache` count.

panels.title: API pods ready
panels.description: Available replicas of the api Deployment (kube-state-metrics).

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Container restarts of the api pods in the last 24 h (OOM kills, crash loops, failed probes).

panels.title: Requests / s by status class
panels.description: Stacked by the first digit of the status code.

panels.title: Requests / s by route (top 10)
panels.description: The ten busiest routes in the time range. `route` is `METHOD /path/:param`, never a concrete id.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Estimated from the `http_request_duration_seconds` histogram (buckets 5 ms – 10 s).

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Requests per latency bucket over time. A bright band at the bottom is the cached / trivial routes, a second band the DOM1 / Trino work.

panels.title: Per route
panels.description: One row per route in the time range: request rate, 5xx share, cache hit share and p95 latency. Sorted by rate.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by route
panels.description: Per cached route. A route that is always missed either has a short TTL, is invalidated on every write, or is keyed too finely.

panels.title: Cache lookups / s
panels.description: Hits are served from Redis without touching a handler; misses run the handler and fill the cache.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the api container (cAdvisor) against its limit. Sustained use near the limit throttles requests.

panels.title: Memory (working set)
panels.description: Reaching the limit means an OOM kill (a restart in the Overview row). DOM1 tile decoding is the usual spike.

panels.title: Event loop lag p99
panels.description: How long a ready callback waited for the Bun event loop. Rising lag means synchronous work (GeoTIFF decoding, big JSON) is blocking request handling.

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: JavaScript heap in use per pod (prom-client default metrics).

panels.title: Log lines / s by level
panels.description: The API logs one JSON line per event with a `level` field. Errors are what reached the error sink (undeclared errors, response-schema violations, exceptions).

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: `warn` = denied requests (401/403) and degraded infrastructure (cache, usage log); `error` = bugs. Each line carries `requestId`; with tracing on also `traceId`, which links to Tempo.

panels.title: All API logs
panels.description: Everything the api containers write. Set `LOG_LEVEL=debug` on the Deployment for a per-request line (route, status, duration).

panels.title: Failed requests (5xx)
panels.description: Root spans that ended in a 500. Open one to see the recorded exception; the same request id is in the error log line.

panels.title: Slow requests (> 2 s)
panels.description: Root spans slower than two seconds. Attributes: `http.route`, `scmp.policy`, `scmp.tenant_id`, `http.request.id`.
